page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 59 at top right. Main text in two short-line columns of numerals (left and right) in the body, continuing as single lines below. No marginal notes. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Vénti: viginti. Vent' uno, vel vna viginti vnus, vna, vnum.
Vénti dúe: viginti duo, vel duæ.
Vénti tre: viginti tres, vel tria.
Vénti cinque: viginti quinque: ac modo consimili vsque ad Trénta: triginta.
Quaránta: quadraginta. Cinquánta: quinquaginta. Sessánta: sexaginta.
Settánta: septuaginta. Ottánta: octoginta. Nouánta: nonaginta.
Céнтo: centum. Cénto & vno, vel vna: centum & vnus, vna, vnum.
Cénto & dúe: centum & duo, vel duæ.
Cénto & tre: centum & tres, vel tria.
Cénto & quáttro: centum & quatuor: ac eodem modo vsque ad Dugénto: ducenti, ducentæ, ducenta, vel bis centū.

page.notes: Several numerals are set in a mixed hand/italic style; some words are partly obscured by show-through from the reverse page and the spine. Transcription of the left and right columns is combined in printed order where the layout is ragged.
